sources.title: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct official README
sources.evidence: Names the exact Instruct release on 2025-08-20; reports nominal 36B, 64-layer causal architecture with GQA, RoPE, RMSNorm and SwiGLU; documents thinking budgets and a Seed-OSS tool-call parser. Reopened for the parameter re-audit; the model summary still gives nominal 36B and no separately labeled active count.

sources.title: Seed-OSS official model card shipped with Instruct
sources.evidence: Lists Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct, ByteDance Seed Team, 2025-08-20 release, Apache 2.0, 524288-token context, and text input/output.

sources.title: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: SeedOssForCausalLM; 64 layers, width 5120, MLP width 27648, 80 query heads and eight KV heads of dimension 128; vocabulary 155136; untied embeddings; BF16; max_position_embeddings 524288.

sources.title: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct checkpoint tensor index and indexed shard headers
sources.evidence: Index explicitly reports total_parameters=36151104512 and total_size=72302209024. HTTP 206 byte-range reads of all 15 indexed shard headers independently sum 771 BF16 weight/bias tensors to exactly 36151104512 elements. Tensor names exactly match the index; no packed tensors, scales or other buffers occur. On October 27, the index metadata and its 771-entry weight map were rechecked; the prior shard-header census is preserved and no weight shards were downloaded in this pass.

sources.title: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct Apache license
sources.evidence: The checkpoint distributes Apache License Version 2.0. MODEL_CARD states its use guidance does not restrict or modify this license.

sources.title: SeedOss implementation at the Transformers revision recommended by ByteDance
sources.evidence: Causal decoder layers each apply dense gate/up/down MLP linear projections and causal grouped-query attention, with no expert router; embeddings and the output projection are separate modules.

sources.title: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct chat template
sources.evidence: Template read through the repository API serializes tool definitions, assistant tool_calls and tool results; supports thinking_budget and explicit reasoning delimiters.

sources.title: Seed-OSS Open-Source Models Release
sources.evidence: The original developer release identifies Instruct as a post-trained version of Seed-OSS-36B-Base. It gives no separate activated-parameter count or convention.

sources.title: Current Seed-OSS official repository README
sources.evidence: Freshly read the model summary and Base/Instruct comparison tables. The size is nominal 36B; Activation Function means SwiGLU, not an activated-parameter count. No activated-parameter column or counting convention appears.

sources.title: Seed1.8 Model Card
sources.evidence: Independently searched the complete 48-page text extracted from a fresh October 27 download for Seed-OSS and active/activated parameter references. No Seed-OSS occurrence or activated-parameter comparison was found.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card
sources.evidence: Independently searched the complete 78-page text extracted from a fresh October 27 download. Seed-OSS occurs only in the introductory list of prior models; no active/activated-parameter comparison or convention was found.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card, June 2026 revision
sources.evidence: Independently searched the complete 87-page text extracted from a fresh October 27 download. Seed-OSS occurs in the introduction and the bibliography link to its original release. No active/activated-parameter comparison or convention was found.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card
sources.evidence: Independently searched the complete 73-page text extracted from a fresh October 27 download for Seed-OSS and active/activated parameter references. No Seed-OSS occurrence or activated-parameter comparison was found.

sources.title: SiliconFlow Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct served-model specification
sources.evidence: The exact served-model page lists 36B total and 36B activated parameters. It supplies no count provenance, ByteDance attribution or counting convention; searches of the provider site and documentation found none. This is a provider claim, not a verified developer specification, and was not adopted.

name.note: The release news and version list identify this exact checkpoint. The README introductory callout has a Base-Instruct typo; the repository identity and explicit release/version lists agree on Instruct.

developer.note: Developed by the ByteDance Seed Team.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the Seed family; the concrete released series is Seed-OSS.

release_date.note: Explicit original release date, not inferred from a repository modification time.

open_weights.note: All 15 official checkpoint shard headers were publicly accessible without credentials; weights are distributed with the stated license.

license.note: Named license retained; exact checkpoint includes the Apache 2.0 text.

parameters_b.note: Retained exact complete checkpoint count in decimal billions: 36,151,104,512. Freshly reopened index metadata reports this count and 771 tensors, matching the previous full shard-header census of learned weights and biases. This includes untied embeddings, dense-layer weights, norms and attention biases; the developer label 36B is nominal.

active_parameters_b.note: The original cards, current official model summary and later Seed1.8/2.0/2.1 texts disclose no separate Seed-OSS activated count or convention. SiliconFlow explicitly lists nominal 36B activated for the exact served model, but does not attribute or define that count; it remains an unverified provider claim. Dense architecture alone is not used to equate active and total parameters. Retain null pending a supported published convention or developer count, not an exact per-token census.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only causal Transformer. The checkpoint and recommended implementation use 64 layers of dense SwiGLU MLPs and GQA attention, not routed experts; RoPE and RMSNorm are documented.

context_window.note: The card spells out 512K as 524,288 tokens and the configuration matches.

modalities.note: The official card explicitly identifies text input and text generation.

reasoning.note: The Instruct instructions and template support adjustable thinking budgets, including a zero-budget direct-answer mode.

tool_call.note: Official inference instructions enable automatic tool choice with the seed_oss parser; the template serializes tool definitions, tool calls and tool responses.

description.value: Text model with long-context instruction following, adjustable reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Plain capability summary of the documented long-context, instruction-following, thinking-budget and tool-call behavior.

patch.description: Text model with long-context instruction following, adjustable reasoning, and tool calling.
patch.notes: 36B is the nominal label; the original BF16 checkpoint contains exactly 36,151,104,512 learned parameters, confirmed by its index metadata and the prior complete header census. ByteDance does not separately specify active parameters in the checked sources; SiliconFlow lists 36B activated without a source or counting convention, so that claim remains unverified.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retained the verified 36.151104512B total after reopening the official index and original cards. Checked the current official repository, original release, and later Seed1.8/2.0/2.1 model cards for an activated count or convention. SiliconFlow lists 36B activated without count provenance; no developer-backed active specification was found, so active parameters remain null. Prior tensor evidence and all other field assessments are preserved.
